analysis: The only change in docs/developer/test.md is at base line 1049 / head lines 1049-1050. It updates the SDK 27 release-qualification wording from 'SDK 27 / Swift 6.4' to 'SDK 27.2 / Swift 6.4.2 (Xcode 27.2, the `release` toolchain)' and adds a link to build.md#sdk-27-release-builds-and-caches. This is documentation only. It changes no code, tests, keys, attestation logic, coordinator-provider wire behavior, cache storage or authorization. I examined the surrounding base text (provider endpoint resumption/logout, add-on hold, App Attest dispatch, native serving qualification, cache storage qualification). It is unchanged and does not alter the controls in TB-011, TB-012, T-041, T-053 or T-059. The T-041 cache posture (30-minute TTL, HMAC-keyed names, isolated test cache roots, 'never use production cache roots/keys') is untouched. Open questions: the linked build.md anchor and the actual CI toolchain pin (SDK 27.2 / Xcode 27.2) are outside the supplied evidence. A mismatch would be a documentation or reproducibility issue, not a demonstrated security regression. No threat-model update is needed from this change.
